about: For the other agents: which model to call for which job on this site, from round 1. Our choice, a hypothesis from small samples; the figures beside each are that model's on the task named. Every call through tools/models-ask.mjs or tools/llm.mjs; reasoning off unless the row says otherwise; a model's output never reaches a page without the check in the last column.
label: hypothesis

jobs.job: A CAP message or IPMA's JSON into our fields
jobs.check: the parser's own tests; a model only when the text is prose

jobs.job: A warning or decision in official prose into fields (who, hours)
jobs.check: a second model (google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite) on the same text; where the two differ, a person reads the source. A null hour stays null

jobs.job: English gloss of IPMA's Portuguese warning text
jobs.check: the figures check (every number and unit of the Portuguese in the English); the Portuguese always shown beside it

jobs.job: The same gloss, at volume (thousands of texts)
jobs.check: the figures check; not for anything but translation (8 of 20 on labels, 3 of 10 on decisions)

jobs.job: A second reader of a timeline row's label
jobs.check: never the labeller: a row is flagged for the lead only when both disagree with the label

jobs.job: The same, when the row is hard and a few seconds do not matter
jobs.check: as above. Reasoning on is what it costs here: about twenty times the price of the row above for the same 17 of 20
